claims.statement: For uniform s in [1,r), input T=[s]P0 and powers A_i=[s^i]P0 for i=1..n on BLS12-381 G1, with n=2^20, recover s. Cheon's p-1 BSGS algorithm in proof.md (using A_1 and A_d with d=2^20 | (r-1) as stated by the track rules) succeeds with probability 1 using at most 2^118.598470 total target-group-operation equivalents at n=2^20, including preprocessing and verification. Peak memory at most 2^124.013508 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^15 group-equivalents (included in total); nonuniform advice 0. Classical cold attack; no quantum steps. Analytic claim; toy experiment does not prove production cost.

experiments.purpose: Check Cheon p-1 BSGS recovers secrets in a small prime field with d|r-1. Toy scope only.
